title: Canvas Interaction Regression After 441
description: Canvas renders but pointer interaction (click, select, deselect) stopped working after commit 441 vs 440; rest of UI OK. Find root cause in diff 440..441 and fix with tests.
summary: Root fix: removed `.lm_goldenlayout * { pointer-events: auto !important }` from elements.css — it forced every GL descendant to auto and broke all intentional pointer-events:none pass-throughs (Window options overlay, toolbars, etc.), blocking board canvas hits. Replaced with explicit pointer-events:auto only on known GL chrome (header, tabs, splitters, drag proxy, popin, controls). Prior attempts (ContextMenu ordering, overlay geometry, per-slot !important) logged in ticket important.md. Tests: bun ./script.ts test in elements/client/lib/board — Rust 57, Vitest 75, Playwright 3 pass / 3 skip.
